$comment: Prompt manifest for the hand-generated art (spec section 8). premiumRedesign records the current shipped visual system and overrides the legacy prompts below for files with the same name. Nothing here is called at runtime.

generation.backgroundException: icon.png is generated on a solid background; see its note.
generation.postProcess: Downscale every file except icon.png to 512x512, then run through an optimiser (oxipng or ImageOptim). These ship to phones over someone's flat wifi.

workflow: 1. Generate chip-01 first and keep regenerating until the style is right. It is the anchor for the whole set.

2. For chip-02 onward, attach chip-01 as a reference image and append this line to the prompt: 'Keep the same chip proportions, softly modelled 3D felt-and-clay finish, rounded forms, dimensional edging and face style as the reference. Change only the body colour and the accessory. Do not redesign the character.'
3. Do the same for winner, broke and empty, which are the same character in different moods.
4. rebuy-burst, pot-stack and icon have no face. Use a finished chip character as a style reference for pot-stack; rebuy-burst and icon need no reference.
5. Save each file under public/art/ using the exact filename in this manifest. The filenames are load-bearing: avatar_key maps straight onto them.
sharedStyle: Polished soft 3D character illustration with tactile felt-and-clay materials, gently rounded forms, subtle two-tone modelling and ambient occlusion, dark dimensional edging, and a limited palette of deep green felt, warm cream, warm red and antique gold. Every player avatar differs by chip colour plus exactly one accessory, so the set reads as a family.

assets.prompt: Create a cinematic wide mobile hero background for a premium private poker ledger. A real red neon sign reading exactly TILTED POKER, photographed at a slight angle in a dark after-hours casino interior, with believable tubing, mounting hardware, reflections, shallow depth of field, black-cherry shadows and restrained haze. Compose it so the sign feels built into the environment rather than pasted onto a card. No people, chips, cards, money, logos, extra words or UI.

Create a dark vertical ambient casino background for a phone UI. Out-of-focus vintage slot machines sit at the far edges and recede into black-cherry darkness; ruby and oxblood practical light reflects softly on worn metal and carpet. Keep the center quiet and low contrast for readable interface content. Premium cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, no people, no readable labels, no logos, no text, no coins or cards.

Create a single premium oval poker table artifact for a portrait phone game screen, viewed nearly top-down with a slight cinematic perspective. Deep oxblood felt center, thick worn black leather rail, subtle red edge light, dark hardwood and restrained metal fasteners, with realistic tactile materials and light signs of use. The whole table must fit inside the frame with generous breathing room and a clean quiet felt area for UI overlays. Solid black-cherry background matching #080305. No players, seats, hands, chips, cards, text, logos, cup holders or UI.

Create a premium square app icon for Tilted Poker: one centered, face-free poker chip rendered in worn black clay, oxblood enamel and restrained ruby edge light on a near-black background. Strong simple silhouette readable at 16 pixels, minimal dimensional bevel, no mascot expression, no letters, words, cards, dice, money, logos, border or outer frame.
